response.summary: The migration is implemented, but the gate retains a false-pass path and does not fully enforce the promised subset/error contract.

findings.evidence: A valid spec with no wave-plan is not fatal. Checks 9 and 10 become FAIL, so --only 9,10 returns exit 1 instead of the promised setup ERROR/exit 2. Gate 4.5's exit-1 branch then writes awaiting-consistency-fix rather than preserving planned. The migrated fixtures cover missing spec, but not missing plan.
findings.fix: Return ERROR/2 for a missing required plan in consistency-gate mode while preserving the full checklist's intended missing-plan behavior. Add a missing-plan gate fixture.

findings.evidence: The suffix comparison accepts project/other/spec/001-login.md when checking project/demo/spec/001-login.md. With matching FR identifiers, both consistency checks pass although the plan links to another project's spec. The same branch also accepts nonexistent paths ending in spec/001-login.md.
findings.fix: Resolve supported absolute and vault-relative links and compare their normalized target with the actual spec path. Reject unrelated project paths and add a same-filename/different-project fixture.

findings.evidence: --only parses tokens with parseInt and rejects unknown IDs only when no checks match. Thus --only 9,100 silently executes only check 9 and can report PASS without validating the spec link; --only 9,10typo is also accepted. This allows configuration mistakes to weaken a blocking gate silently.
findings.fix: Validate every token as a complete integer and require every requested ID to exist before evaluating checks. Return setup ERROR/2 for malformed or unknown IDs, including mixed valid/invalid lists.

coverage: Read the supplied plan and M13 STATUS/VERIFICATION artifacts.
Inspected checklist input loading, rule evaluation, subset selection, reporting, saved-report writing and fixture expectations.
Traced Gate 4.5 callers, planning handoff, re-entry routing and spec status writes.
Inspected FR extraction primitives, CLI references, installer lists and install-sync references.
Reviewed agent structural-tag search results, Erik lesson pointers and Ludwig comparison document.
limitations: No tests were run and no files were edited.
Historical verification claims, CI status and clean-HOME installation were not independently reproduced.
The external legal plugin was not inspected; its comparison document was reviewed as repository evidence only.
Agent conversion fidelity and lifecycle-workflow equivalence were not exhaustively compared against historical versions.
